messages:
Maya: moved my mesh node to the bookshelf — evening Zoom latency dropped like 80% :raised_hands: anyone else living with ethernet spaghetti under their desk?
Devon: oh yea. it looks like a can of sardines back there. cat sits on the cables for warmth. pic incoming (not showing here). :sweat_smile:
Sam: quick poll — emergency fallback when home wifi dies: 1) phone hotspot 2) neighbor wifi 3) go to a cafe? React with 1/2/3.
Maya: 1 for me. had to tether during the last deploy. :grimacing:
Devon: 3 during daytime, 1 at night. pro tip: set your phone hotspot to 5GHz if available, less interference.
Sam: useful. also if you're on Linux, `nmcli` saved me for connecting to the hotspot quickly after a router reboot.
Sam: setup snippet I keep in notes:
```
# connect to hotspot on Linux
nmcli device wifi connect "MyPhone-5G" password "hunter2"
```
Aisha: low-cost UPS rec: APC BE600. survived a toddler + coffee test. :thumbsup:
Devon: tape your dongles to the laptop. saved me once when I nearly yanked the ethernet out mid-call.
OpsBot: Heads-up: scheduled network maintenance in us-west-2 tonight 23:00-23:30 UTC may affect VPNs and some private deployments.
Sam: ugh, thanks @OpsBot — of course it's tonight. will switch my critical tests to hosted tomorrow.
Maya: can anyone recommend a compact surge protector? spilled coffee on mine last week (RIP).
Aisha: Anker PowerExtend 6-outlet — compact, good reviews. survived one coffee apocalypse here. :coffee:
Devon: results so far: 1=2, 2=0, 3=1. poll closed? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Maya: also bonus note: my lava lamp apparently doubles as an ambient wifi-signal reflector. not scientific. :lava_lamp:
Sam: lava lamp anecdote wins this thread. :trophy:
Devon: bedtime for me. will post a before/after cable tidy tomorrow if anyone's curious. goodnight!
Maya: night all!
